inputs.checklistItemText: Transformer pads not located 100% on private property, located in public right-of-way, or straddling property lines
inputs.question: Are all five transformer pads clearly shown to be located within the property lines of the private site, or do any appear to be straddling the property boundary or located within an easement that might be in the public right-of-way?

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether transformer pads are visibly located within property lines versus straddling boundaries or in public ROW—this is a presence/location verification question (do the pads appear to be on private property?), not a distance measurement between two features. While the requirement concerns property-line compliance, the agent question is asking for visual confirmation of pad positioning relative to drawn property boundaries, which is a feature-location check rather than a clearance measurement.
